rule_or_pattern: drop lines flagged D:column_crossing_line, C:cpp_vs_book_out or C:len_vs_book_high (also catches labels containing ' | ' that join the Greek and French columns)
notes: 1889-90 diplomatic correspondence printed as a Greek|French parallel-column bilingual edition. The French majority is genuine, and single-column lines in both languages read correctly (1-9, 11-20). The errors cluster in two flagged groups: column merges, where the Greek half-line and the French half-line are joined with '|' (21-24, 27, 28, 36), and lines flagged C:cpp_vs_book_out, whose labels are short fragments of a different line than the crop (25, 26, 30-33, 37-40). One unflagged random line (10) has the same mismatch, so a small residue remains.
